Synopsis:
Wulbren is holding counsel with his fellow gnomes (if they survived moonrise) when he is interrupted by the player. He is condescending a arrogant. We can discover a little about the ironhand gnomes.

Cluster Contexts:
- HAV_WrootRequest_Wulbren.json: Wulbren is the proud, condescending leader of the Ironhand gnomes and is mid‑counsel with his fellow gnomes (assuming they survived the Moonrise attack) when the player intrudes. Off‑screen the gnomes are likely imprisoned in Moonrise Towers and already cobbling together a fragile jailbreak—prying at a weak basalt wall, improvising tools, and missing equipment while staying wary of cult patrols. The player has already antagonized Wulbren (an earlier insult like “prick” makes him bristle), so his replies will be smug, dismissive, or passively hostile rather than cooperative. Cult sentries or magical scrying eyes (for example the Warden or a half‑orc executioner) may be nearby and able to cut the conversation short, and the exchange can reveal small details about Ironhand tactics and allies (fanatically loyal gnomes like Nimble, anxious savants like Nickles) as well as the wider prisoner situation that includes captured tieflings.
- SCE_Wulbren.json: This dialogue is peak Wulbren. If he's met you in haven (after you saved him), he rolls back on how rude he was as he realises the player would be an amazing asset in the city. If this is your first time meeting him since the escape (if haven is destroyed he waits out on the river until this scene in the epilogue), he realises how good the player would be to have on his side in the city and tells him all about how wronged the ironhand gnomes were.
- MOO_Jailbreak_Wulbren.json: Wulbren Bongle is the charismatic, cunning leader of the Ironhand Gnomes, currently held in Moonrise Towers and offering the main quest: free him and the captured tieflings. He can speak through the bars whether the player is locked up or standing outside, and he keeps a tightly‑worn mask of friendly, arrogant charm while probing your motives and nudging you toward rescue (with a faint, controlled hint of menace). Off‑screen the cellblock is under tight surveillance: a sadistic half‑orc Absolute jailer patrols nearby, can telepathically check for tadpoles, control movement, and will report trouble (up to Disciple Z’rell), and the tower is on high alert after recent Execution/Audience events. Several tieflings (Cal, Lia, Lakrissa, and the absent Rolan) are relevant to any jailbreak plot — some in neighboring cells, others restrained elsewhere — and Wulbren speaks like a leader used to giving orders and exploiting weak points (literal or political) while sizing up whether you’re friend or foe.
- HAV_WrootRequest_UnfortunateGnome.json: The unfortunate gnome is playing with his powders, his mood downcast and face smeared with soot. He's learnt that the gnomes are at Moonrise. He'll ask us again to help them if we haven't agreed already. He has nodes to cover alternate states in HAV, but not as many as e.g. harpers. He is mostly concerned with Wulbren, and other matters are of little import to him.This dialogue will be expanded when we have clear messaging around what happened to the gnomes in HAV and how Barcus should react to them.
- CAMP_GoblinHuntCelebration_UnfortunateGnome.json: Unfortunate gnome's dialog after the goblin hunt celebration party. There are actually two different dialoues: one for when the player sided with the goblins, in which he is pissed off at the player and ready to leave, and one where the player sided with the tieflings, in which he is happy for them, but doesn't want to partake in the celebrations himself, since it has nothing to do with him, and he wants to go save his friend as soon as possible. In this case, he's standing next to a workbench, working on making explosive arrows (ARR_Arrow_Of_Fire).

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Wulbren Bongle: Excuse me. This prick is busy. Why don't you and Barcus go entertain each other elsewhere. || [context] NodeContext: Player called him a prick earlier, so Wulbren is bristling (node 82)
- Player: Once a prick, always a prick. (node 40)
